reviews_captured_by_me.text: I'm sorry to say our experience was very unsatisfactory. Communication with them was difficult after then down payment was made. We were told it would be 1 month to get materials for job. Calls and texts were not responded to. 3 months later job date was finally scheduled. This was a remodel, we were not advised as to our prep. Either the estimator or front office. We had been functioning in a partial kitchen waiting on them. We had loosened what remained of our countertop and had sink disconnected at their arrival. We were charged extra 300 bc they had to help carry what remained 20 feet to the garage. It would have been had we known. We were not told to completely clear lower cabinets. To the finish, we were told it would be seamless at the join of the 2 pieces. Not only can you see it you can feel a divit in the Corian. The installer ground on it without adequate ventilation for at least 30plus minutes.  Copious dust. I expressed our dissatisfaction via text along with photos that visibility show the seam. Lisa did respond and said she would check with installer and get back with us. Again 3 months have passed, and nothing. Would Not recommend this company.
Fabulous, took care of my needs at a Great price. Thanks guys

Initially went into Home Depot for new countertops around around the mid August time frame, their end was fairly straight forward with picking it out and explaining that they would use M&L for the install and cutting. They explained that they would contact me to set up a date to confirm the measurements, after not being contacted for a couple weeks I had given them and home depot a call and finally was able find a date to confirm a date to have it confirmed. After that it was silence again. The most difficult part of this entire experience was that M&L would never answer the phone or return any phone calls, I would constantly have to go through home depot who would then find a way to contact them and finally contact me after several attempts and left messages.

I did finally get it installed I believed mid to late October. After it was installed I noticed part of the back splash was not level, which started the whole contact issue again, extremely difficult to get ahold of anyone so I went through home depot once again and finally got them to call back and come take the piece that wasn't level. The piece was taken towards the end of December and I was told it would be a fairly quick turnaround. I understand the holidays may delay things but again even just trying to get someone to answer for an update has been nearly impossible.
